fields.validator: Pocket lifecycle/bounds validation; native monotonic-revision receiver
fields.commit: Authoritative host persists state; scene updates presentation only
fields.limit: A relay ACK is not permission for a local HP/MP or inventory debit.

fields.validator: Nonempty identities, finite coordinates, atRevision ≤ snapshot revision
fields.commit: Server owns resource reset; receiver applies one teleport per new respawn revision
fields.limit: Malformed or old snapshots never restore a local authority writer.

fields.writer: Client authors input intentions, not canonical vitals
fields.validator: Pocket allowlist/boolean validation and session binding
fields.commit: Dedicated transient input route, outside save-operation queue
fields.limit: Input flags are not proof that the server accepted movement or granted resources.

fields.writer: Client requests; Pirate server computes costs and effects
fields.validator: Pocket bounded request; Pirate trusted catalog, entitlement and cooldown
fields.commit: Canonical state plus receipt is returned for authoritative persistence
fields.limit: Retries replay the same receipt; neither HP nor MP quickslots consume locally under server authority.

fields.writer: Parent binds command identity and observed revision
fields.validator: Active session, operation allowlist, bounds and server revision/receipt checks
fields.commit: Outer authenticated transaction host; Pirate worker provides domain transitions
fields.limit: The standalone worker and injected HTTP/CAS tests do not prove a deployed SQL transaction.

fields.writer: Server computes unitPrice, stock and fee from canonical market
fields.validator: Pocket request shape; Pirate quote parser and real economy engine
fields.commit: Read-only quote; player and market unchanged
fields.limit: pirate-fruit is a transport zone, not a trade IslandId; use the actual island.

fields.writer: Server owns prices, stock, cargo and canonical coin results
fields.validator: Trusted quote, active boat capacity, funds, stock and duplicate receipt checks
fields.commit: Player aggregate and nextMarket must commit together in the outer host
fields.limit: expectedUnitPrice is a tolerance hint, not a client-authored price. Replay must not debit twice.

fields.direction: Client intent upstream; server world snapshot downstream
fields.writer: Client authors intent; Pirate central worker authors monster outcomes
fields.validator: Bounded schemas, server combat/range rules and generation/sequence checks
fields.commit: World authority mutates monster state; parent only relays results
fields.limit: Do not conflate visual presence, transport zone and gameplay damage/HP authority.

fields.writer: Server monster hit queue and canonical damage adapter
fields.validator: Known hit, owner binding and frozen hit-frame context
fields.commit: ACK follows successful outer SQL/CAS commit
fields.limit: This ACK is not a public client operation and is not evidence of a live host deployment.
